# Agent operating instructions for OctoCAT Supply

## Allowed
- Read/edit files under `api/`, `frontend/`, and `test/`
- Run `npm test`, `npm run lint`, `make test`
- Read GitHub issues and PRs via MCP

## Forbidden
- Editing anything under `infra/` or `.github/workflows/`
- Modifying `package.json` dependencies without explicit instruction
- Pushing to `main` directly

## Conventions
- All API changes must update `api/openapi.yaml`
- Always run `npm test` after edits; do not finish if tests fail
- Prefer functional React components and Tailwind utility classes
